verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents its own deployment choices: fully managed on AWS, Google Cloud or Azure, or BYOC inside your own AWS or Google Cloud account, where your data never leaves your cloud. That gives users real control over where data lives, but nothing in the evidence shows choosing a specific region or making residency commitments. missing for 10: explicit region selection for managed clusters, documented data-residency/geographic guarantees, list of available regions, independent corroboration.
